localFixes.why: renamed to flat.js: a preset file named `eslint.config.js` that reads `tseslint.configs.*` registers its own directory with typescript-eslint as a candidate tsconfigRootDir (it inspects the call stack for that file name). A consumer's own `eslint.config.js` is a second candidate, so every .ts file then fails with 'No tsconfigRootDir was set, and multiple candidate TSConfigRootDirs are present' — the README's documented usage. Library presets must not carry that file name.
